prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-viewport background for an immersive sound garden web app, landscape 1536x1024. A quiet moonlit lake shore in a dreamlike botanical world. Cinematic realistic 3D environment with delicate organic detail, muted midnight teal, deep forest green, faint warm ivory highlights, no neon. A small dark moss-covered oval island is centered at 58 percent horizontal, 72 percent vertical, emerging from glassy shallow lake water. Keep this island bare for a procedurally animated luminous sound plant that the application will draw there. Fern leaves and grasses softly frame the bottom corners, fine mist over water, distant shadowy tree silhouettes, a subtle moon glow high right. Beautiful soft grain, rich depth, subdued natural lighting, reflective water. Left third dark and uncluttered for large Chinese typography, top and bottom also clear for interface. No text, no UI, no people, no bottle, no flowers or existing tree on central island, no logo, no watermark. Make it feel like a private place someone would enter at 11pm to listen to a voice and feel less alone.

story.title: 新城市的第一个晚上
story.audio: original Web Audio score; no human or synthetic speech
